description: This file defines the 'PipelineElementVisitor' interface which provides a visitor pattern for evaluating pipeline elements, including methods for handling resolved values, unresolved (failed) resolution, and deletions. It also contains a nested 'Builder' interface for constructing such visitors with customizable callbacks.

classes.name: PipelineElementVisitor
classes.description: A visitor interface for evaluating pipeline elements with methods for handling resolved, unresolved, and deleted states.

classes.name: PipelineElementVisitor.Builder
classes.description: A builder interface for constructing 'PipelineElementVisitor' instances with custom behavior.

methods.name: resolved
methods.description: Evaluates a resolved value using the provided function.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Handles deletion of the entire string containing the pipeline.

methods.name: resolved
methods.description: Sets the callback for handling resolved values in the builder.

methods.name: unresolved
methods.description: Sets the callback for handling resolution failures in the builder.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Sets the callback for handling deletions in the builder.
